decision: PENDING — to be replaced with Sam's verified decision before the digest is published
purpose: PO Draft create/update routes are reachable only with purchasing.mgmt, require Idempotency-Key equal to eventId, refuse client-computed or mistyped fields with PURCHASING_INPUT_INVALID and a field path, replay the same key and reject a changed body, return 201/200 and 409 with only currentVersion, and wire the real providers. Also re-pins the purchasing-task012 files, whose content is unchanged, because the HD-016 revision changed the manifest, design and task documents those tests read
data: Handler file: no database. API file: two cases through the real application and HTTP; each commits minimal masters (HKD, no Payment Term) and one or two POs, deletes the POs and masters afterwards, and leaves its operation and audit rows plus the current month's purchasing_document_sequences row (those tables refuse DELETE). Re-pinned files keep the purchasing-task012 data unchanged. No fixture files
concurrency: None in the new files; re-pinned files unchanged
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing server test jobs
cost: Measured locally: API file about 1.7 s and handler file about 0.1 s wall time; re-pinned files unchanged. CI not measured, estimated under three seconds added. No new job and no capacity

cases: Create 經 HTTP 回 201；同 key 同內容 replay、同 key 唔同內容 409；key 同 eventId 唔一致或者帶 client total 被拒
Update 經 HTTP 回 200；舊 version 409 只回 currentVersion；冇 purchasing.mgmt 403、冇 token 401
Handler metadata：POST、jwt、只要 purchasing.mgmt、開 idempotency、create 201／update 200
Handler 用真 provider 同 config 組 service：Supplier 接 Business Master，audit 上限跟 config
Create 將 JWT claims、原 body 同 request context 交畀 service，回 201
Update 要 version，PO ID 嚟自 path，回 200
Idempotency-Key 一定要同 eventId 逐字相同；冇 key 或者唔同都唔叫 service
Schema 拒絕 client total、快照、factor、Base quantity、status 同 line ID（create），錯誤帶欄位路徑
數量同金額要係原本嘅字串，唔會 coerce；其他型別錯誤都指出欄位
TASK-011 migrations create the four tables in the approved shape and rerun as no-ops
TASK-011 the settings default is seeded only when missing and never overwrites a saved value
TASK-011 document sequences are isolated by type and month and bounded by CHECK
TASK-011 purchase order numbers, status and currency precision are enforced by the database
TASK-011 the ordering address must belong to the PO's Supplier, and deleted actors become NULL
TASK-011 purchase order lines enforce UOM ownership, bounds, the receipt identity and decimal precision
TASK-011 each migration creates exactly one table, so a failure points at one file
TASK-012 migrations create the operation, audit and trigger schema and rerun as no-ops
TASK-012 an operation is unique per document, line and event, and its identity is validated
TASK-012 an operation completes once, then its identity and outcome are frozen
TASK-012 audit rows are append-only, bounded, and keep working when an actor is deleted
TASK-012 a confirmed PO freezes its commercial fields but keeps lifecycle fields writable
TASK-012 lines of a non-DRAFT PO cannot be edited, added or removed, but projections can
TASK-012 document numbers only move forward and are never deleted
TASK-012 every PO and line column is classified once, triggers drift fails closed, and migrations only add
HD-013 open and historical counts follow the PO status a document is in
HD-013 no purchase_orders table means not installed, and no references means ready with zero counts
HD-013 the watermark changes when a referencing PO changes and only then
HD-013 unclassified statuses, malformed counts and invalid subjects fail closed
HD-013 every status the schema allows is classified exactly once
TC-012 real HTTP authentication and authorized admin flow
TC-006 (MIG-006): adding Supplier to an existing deployment changes no existing table or row, writes only Supplier tables and its permission seed, drops nothing it does not own, and the server starts
TASK-010 the defaults are the §12.1 values and the result is frozen
TASK-010 every setting must be a positive safe integer within its limit
TASK-010 unknown settings and schema-bound constants cannot be configured
TASK-010 IDs are positive safe integers
TASK-010 eventId is a canonical lowercase UUID the Inventory provider will accept
TASK-010 dates are real calendar days in YYYY-MM-DD
TASK-010 reason is trimmed to 5..500 characters; notes and references are bounded free text
TASK-010 objects are allowlisted, so client totals, snapshots and status never get through
TASK-010 line and detail arrays need at least one item and respect the configured cap
TASK-010 errors carry a stable code and a field name, never the submitted value
global configuration validation normalizes every configuration section
